# #272: a report entry with no PURL, PkgID or PkgName stops the run before any
# LLM call: the mock fails if called, and no VEX, attestation or temp file is left.
env VENS_MOCK_LLM_FAIL=1
! exec vens generate --llm=mock --attest --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'cannot generate VEX: 1 vulnerability with no component \(empty BOMRef\): CVE-2024-5678'
! stderr 'forced failure'
! exists out.cdx.json
! exists out.attestation.cdx.json
! exec sh -c 'ls .vens-*.tmp'

-- config.yaml --
project:
  name: "empty-bomref-test"
  description: "A report entry with no component"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
